name: lamp
title: Lamp
description: A deep navy panel with a bright cyan lip and a soft cone of light fanning downward over a centred headline. On entering view the light widens and the words rise and fade in.
use: A dark hero needs a single elegant light source to frame a short headline.
avoid: You need strong text contrast, or an effect that keeps moving after it loads.
a11y: The lamp widens on view with no reduced-motion check, and the headline comes from the demo. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A deep navy-black panel with a thin bright cyan line near the top and a soft cyan cone of light spilling down from it like a lamp. Below the light, a two-line grey headline sits centred, fading darker toward its lower line.
behaves: As it enters view the lamp cone and its bright lip widen from narrow to full over about a second, while the headline drifts up and fades in just after. Both settle and stay still; the pointer does nothing.
customise: children is the headline or whatever sits under the light, and className styles the container. The cyan palette, cone widths and timings are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A handful of blurred cyan gradient layers animated once into view.
